description: init.sh builds .venv, lints, checks links and runs every test offline. A conftest guard fails tests that reach the network.

Internal model (trace, span, kind, name, start, end, tokens, error, tool name, parent) and two converters: OTLP JSON with GenAI attributes and JSON Lines. The OTel example and the JSONL example read into the same model.
Seeded trace generator with eight planted failure types, clean traces with benign noise, and ground truth kept outside the traces.
tool_error_loop detector with tests on a faulty and a clean trace.
repeated_calls detector with tests.
context_overflow detector with tests.
wrong_tool detector with tests.
timeout detector with tests.
budget_exhaustion detector with tests.
unknown_tool detector with tests.
handoff_drop detector with tests.
Per trace cost, latency, critical path and retries. Safe on cycles and deep nesting.
Signature clustering: normalized error text plus the tool call n-gram. The embedding variant is blocked and logged.
Static HTML report with summary, top clusters and inline SVG waterfalls. All trace text is escaped. A test plants script tags and HTML.
tracefault scan prints findings and exits 0, 1 or 2. Exit codes are documented in the README and tested.
Thresholds tuned on seed 1. Precision and recall with 95% intervals for each failure type on 1,600 traces from held-out seed 2026, plus a second seed.
README number blocks and docs/index.html are written by a script from the results files. A test fails on a stale or hand-typed number.
Quality bar files: CI with badge, issue templates, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG, topics, social preview 1280x640, static results page, DEMO transcript, link checker, writing rules.
docs/WALKTHROUGH.md, docs/INTERVIEW_QA.md with about 15 answers tied to code and results, and DECISIONS.md.
Release check (review, gitleaks, pip-audit, ruff S, actionlint, link check, outside check) and hand-off (CHANGELOG SHA, HUMAN_STEPS, GITHUB_ABOUT).
